decisions.reason: Because it fits the firm's core secure-communication and second-channel positioning and remained visible after launch, management would likely see performance as near aspiration and keep it unless stronger alternatives for the same resources emerge.

As a core architectural security offering that gained its own page, it likely met or exceeded aspiration levels and is closely tied to the firm's long-term strategic direction, so it would be retained.

Although hardware-based signature tools are somewhat riskier and more niche, the product is close to the firm's established capabilities and compliance-oriented customer base, so available organizational slack supports keeping it for now.

Because it appears more peripheral and received limited website emphasis despite a growing market, management would likely judge it as more likely below aspiration and reallocate resources to stronger identity and signing offerings.
